name: add_entity
description: Add a new object to the scene and return its generated entity id. Every primitive is 1 unit wide and 1 unit deep at scale [1, 1, 1] and is centred on its position; heights are 1 unit except Capsule (1.5), Plane (0), Torus (0.3) and Hemisphere (0.5). Fields you omit fall back to their defaults.

geometry.description: Shape of the object. One of: Cube, Sphere, Cylinder, Cone, Capsule, Plane, Torus, Hemisphere.

position.description: World position of the object's centre as [x, y, z]. Y is up. Defaults to [0, 0, 0].

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees as [x, y, z]. Defaults to [0, 0, 0].

scale.description: Scale factor per axis as [x, y, z]. Every value must be greater than 0. Defaults to [1, 1, 1].

color.description: Colour as a hex string in #rrggbb form. Defaults to #ffffff.

opacity.description: Opacity from 0 (fully transparent) to 1 (fully solid). Defaults to 1.

roughness.description: Surface roughness from 0 (mirror-like) to 1 (fully diffuse). Defaults to 0.5.

name.description: Human-readable label for the object, for example "table top". Defaults to an empty label.

name: finish
description: Call this when the scene is complete and there is nothing left to do. It ends the session; any tool call made after it is rejected.

name: get_entity
description: Return one entity as JSON, by id. Use it to check a single object without reading the whole scene.

entityId.description: Id of the entity, as returned by add_entity or listed by get_scene.

name: get_scene
description: Return the whole scene as JSON: the current scene version and every entity with its id and its components (transform, mesh_filter, mesh_renderer, entity_name). Use it to check the current state before deciding what to change.

name: move_entity
description: Move an existing entity to an absolute world position. The position replaces the current one, it is not added to it.

entityId.description: Id of the entity, as returned by add_entity or listed by get_scene.

position.description: Target world position of the object's centre as [x, y, z]. Y is up.

name: remove_entity
description: Delete an entity from the scene. This cannot be undone.

entityId.description: Id of the entity, as returned by add_entity or listed by get_scene.

name: rename_entity
description: Change an existing entity's label. The entity id stays the same.

entityId.description: Id of the entity, as returned by add_entity or listed by get_scene.

name.description: New human-readable label for the entity.

name: rotate_entity
description: Set an existing entity's rotation, in degrees. The rotation replaces the current one, it is not added to it.

entityId.description: Id of the entity, as returned by add_entity or listed by get_scene.

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees as [x, y, z].

name: scale_entity
description: Set an existing entity's scale factors. The scale replaces the current one, it is not multiplied by it.

entityId.description: Id of the entity, as returned by add_entity or listed by get_scene.

scale.description: Scale factor per axis as [x, y, z]. Every value must be greater than 0.

name: set_material
description: Change how an existing entity looks. Only the fields you pass are changed; every field you omit keeps its current value.

entityId.description: Id of the entity, as returned by add_entity or listed by get_scene.

color.description: New colour as a hex string in #rrggbb form. Omit to keep the current colour.

opacity.description: New opacity from 0 (fully transparent) to 1 (fully solid). Omit to keep the current opacity.

metalness.description: New metalness from 0 (non-metal) to 1 (metal). Omit to keep the current metalness.

roughness.description: New surface roughness from 0 (mirror-like) to 1 (fully diffuse). Omit to keep the current roughness.
